छद्: √1chad (channá; chādáyati; chādayā́ṃ cakre; chāditá; chādayitvā́; -chā́dya). cover; cover over. + ā, cover over; conceal, 2510. + pari, envelope, cover over. + pra, cover; clothe one's self with (instr.).

√2chad or chand (chántti; cacchánda; ácchān [8902]; chadáyati [mgs 1, 2]; chandáyati [mg 3]; chandayā́m āsa; chanditá). 	—1. appear, seem; 	—2. seem good to, please; 	—3. (please a person, acc., with a thing, instr., i. e.) offer a person,  acc., a thing, instr. [prob. ident. w. √ścand.]
छल: chala, m. n. (perhaps cover, i. e.) guise, disguise; pretence, deceit. [perhaps fr. √1chad.]
छाग: chā́ga, m. goat. [for *skāga: cf. Germanic skēpo-, for *skēqo-, Ger. Schaf, AS. sceāp, Eng. sheep.]
छाया: chāyā́, f. shade; shadow; image. [cf. σκιά, ‘shadow.’]
छायाद्वितीय: chāyā-dvitīya, a. having one's shadow as second, accompanied by one's shadow. [1302b.]
छिद्: √chid (chinátti; cicchéda; ácchaitsīt; chetsyáti; chinná; chéttum; chittvā́; -chídya; chidyáte). 	—1. cut off; hew down; sever; cut in two; nibble; 	—2. divide. [cf. σχίζω, √σχιδ, ‘split’; Lat. scindo, scidi, ‘cut’; AS. sceādan, ‘divide,’ Eng. water-shed, ‘the divide between two valleys.’] + ud, 	—1. cut out; 	—2. destroy; --pass. be cut off, fail, be lacking. + vi, cut asunder; sever.
छिद्र: chidrá, n. hole; defect; weak spot. [√chid.]
छेद: cheda, m. cut; cutting off; failure, dearth. [√chid.]
